Bank New York Mellon Corp. (BK) Shareholder Trian Fund Management LP Lowered Position
May 19, 2018 - By Darrin Black
Investors sentiment decreased to 0.99 in Q4 2017. Its down 0.02, from 1.01 in 2017Q3. It fall, as 39 investors sold BK shares while 318 reduced holdings. 99 funds opened positions while 253 raised stakes. 824.52 million shares or 0.99% less from 832.75 million shares in 2017Q3 were reported. National Registered Investment Advisor reported 16,039 shares. Basswood Limited Liability owns 0.4% invested in The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation (NYSE:BK) for 159,912 shares. Rothschild Asset Mgmt accumulated 0.01% or 11,116 shares. Asset invested in 0.09% or 11,885 shares. Voya Invest Management Limited Liability stated it has 551,438 shares or 0.06% of all its holdings. Moreover, Lombard Odier Asset Mgmt (Europe) has 0.04% invested in The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation (NYSE:BK). Curbstone Financial Management holds 0.15% or 4,950 shares in its portfolio. Moreover, Lombard Odier Asset (Switzerland) Sa has 0.03% invested in The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation (NYSE:BK) for 5,119 shares. Webster Comml Bank N A holds 0.03% or 3,458 shares. Murphy Pohlad Asset Management Ltd Liability, Minnesota-based fund reported 102,311 shares. Howe & Rusling Inc reported 720 shares. The New York-based Sg Americas Securities Limited Liability Company has invested 0.1% in The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation (NYSE:BK). Ally Fin Incorporated has 30,000 shares for 0.31% of their portfolio. Cambridge Tru has 0.03% invested in The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation (NYSE:BK) for 7,484 shares. Canada Pension Plan Invest Board reported 689,946 shares.
Nelson Peltz decreased its stake in Bank New York Mellon Corp. (BK) by 29.49% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Trian Fund Management Lp sold 6.60M shares as the company’s stock declined 6.07% with the market. The hedge fund run by Nelson Peltz held 15.78 million shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $849.72M, down from 22.38M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Trian Fund Management Lp who had been investing in Bank New York Mellon Corp. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $57.57B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.56% or $0.32 during the last trading session, reaching $56.96. About 3.82M shares traded. The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation (NYSE:BK) has risen 9.66% since May 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 1.89% the S&P500.
Trian Fund Management Lp, which manages about $8.60B and $11.82 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Pentair Plc (NYSE:PNR) by 210,876 shares to 15.41M shares, valued at $1.09 billion in 2017Q4, according to the filing.
Analysts await The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation (NYSE:BK) to report earnings on July, 19. They expect $1.03 earnings per share, up 11.96 % or $0.11 from last year’s $0.92 per share. BK’s profit will be $1.04 billion for 13.83 P/E if the $1.03 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.10 actual earnings per share reported by The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -6.36 % negative EPS growth.
